# Best chargers for charging many AA/AAA NiMH cells at once

Most of these sources are affiliate roundups rather than hands-on tests, so treat the rankings as a shortlist.

## My pick for 16+ cells: Tenergy TN438 16-bay
- It charges AA and AAA NiMH/NiCd in any combination, each cell independently.
- A large LCD shows the status of each cell.
- It has overcharge, overheat, short-circuit and reverse-polarity protection, plus an 8-hour timer ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-battery-charger/)).
- The sources gave no price for it, and I don't have a verified purchase link. Search the exact model "Tenergy TN438" at Tenergy's store or Amazon.

## Other 16-bay options
- **BONAI 16-bay:** Takes any quantity in any slot and mixes AA and AAA. It runs on 110-240V AC with a built-in plug (no power brick) and delivers 250-500 mA per port. Per-port LEDs flag faulty cells. It's NiMH only, with no alkaline or lithium ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-aa-battery-chargers/)).
- **POWEROWL 16-bay:** Has 16 independent channels and a four-stage charge (pre-charge, quick, float, trickle) ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-aa-battery-chargers/)).
- **CITYORK 16-bay:** Has a smart LCD and a ventilated, heat-dissipating design ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-battery-charger/)).
- **EBL 12+2 bay:** Handles 12 AA/AAA slots plus C/D and 9V, which helps if you have mixed battery types ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-battery-charger/)).

## Best 8-bay value: Tenergy TN480U
- It costs **$23.99** at Tenergy's US store, verified 2026-10-21, and no discount code applied.
- It has eight mixed AA/AAA bays and a per-slot LCD. It charges at 500 mA per AA and 250 mA per AAA, and it detects bad cells.
- It takes USB-C or Micro-USB input at 5V/2A. No wall adapter is included, and on a 1A source, five or more AA cells charge at only 250 mA each.
- It comes with a 12-month warranty and 30-day returns, and you pay return shipping.
- **Buy:** [Tenergy TN480U at Tenergy's official store](https://dealectric.com/go/tenergy-tn480u-8-bay-nimh-charger). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you. [Product details](https://dealectric.com/tenergy-tn480u-8-bay-nimh-charger).

## Other 8-bay options
- **EBL 8-bay:** Has independent slots and per-slot LEDs for charging, full and bad cell, with fire-resistant materials ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-aa-aaa-charger/)).
- **HiQuick 8-bay:** Is built around high-capacity 2800 mAh AAs and claims about 2 hours for AAA and 4.5 hours for AA ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-aa-battery-charger/)).

## Things to know
- Charge time grows with how many cells are loaded, and these sources don't say whether a 16-bay holds its per-slot current when full.
- Independent slots matter, so one weak cell doesn't hold up the rest.
- For the BONAI, EBL, POWEROWL and HiQuick, the sources only link through Amazon "Check Price" buttons. I don't have verified product URLs, so check current price and reviews on the listing before buying.

If you tell me roughly how many cells you need to charge and your budget, I can narrow this to one.
